lines.explanation: The task is read-only (listing roster members with workspaces, filtered by who authored launch-related messages in C_LAUNCH1/C_LAUNCH2), so it is active regardless of resolution state. The agent fetched users.info for all four roster candidates (all showing team_id T_ACME) and conversations.history for both audit channels, then correctly identified U_ROSTER1 (authored 'Launch checklist is finalized...' in C_LAUNCH1) and U_ROSTER3 (authored 'Can we push the launch date...' in C_LAUNCH2) as the qualifying members, matching the card's referent set exactly. It correctly excluded U_ROSTER2 (posted in C_LAUNCH1 but message ('Standup notes...') did not reference launch) and U_ROSTER4 (did not post in either audit channel, despite being a member of C_GENERAL where an unrelated message exists). Both included entries report the correct profile-shown workspace T_ACME. The intro paragraphs (noting completion in a prior turn and framing the results table) and the results/exclusion table together constitute the full requested deliverable. An earlier intermediate/hallucinated-looking tool output in step 5 (assistant_text) was discarded and re-fetched cleanly in steps 6-7, with the corrected data used in the final answer, so it does not affect the delivered result.
